options.name: file_url
options.description: CPLD image file path. Required when I(list=False).

options.name: host
options.description: Specifies the DNS host name or address for connecting to the remote device over the specified transport.  The value of host is used as the destination address for the transport.

options.name: id
options.description: CPLD id. Required when I(list=False). Only the M5 model supports this parameter.

options.name: list
options.description: Get cpld list. Only the M5 model supports this parameter.

options.name: password
options.description: Specifies the password to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ANSIBLE_NET_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: username
options.description: Configures the username to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ANSIBLE_NET_USERNAME) will be used instead.
